_comment: The Sounders (#3643, docs/developer/CIVILIZATIONS.md): the singing people of Soaniri (docs/developer/STORY_SOUNDERS.md). A legacy civilization — a tag only: Soaniri, its castle, the Choir Tower and the story's sites keep their own stampers, seeds, records and loot; the blocks, items, templates and loot tables that name "sounders" are grouped under it. Most of the people went over in the Great Song and a few still hum in Mirun — "lost" is the closest state there is so far.
